description: This file declares the 'ReportPosition' class, which implements the 'IPlayerTask' interface. It is part of the 'firebolt::rialto::server::tasks::generic' namespace and is responsible for reporting the position in a media player context. The class holds references to a 'GenericPlayerContext', a 'IGstGenericPlayerClient', and a shared pointer to 'IGstWrapper'.

classes.name: ReportPosition
classes.description: A class that implements the 'IPlayerTask' interface to report the current position in a media playback context.

methods.name: ReportPosition
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the 'ReportPosition' task with the given context, client, and gstWrapper.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the task to report the current position.
